name: Dr. Amara Okafor
intro: Amara leads Aurelia's restorative team and has spent nearly two decades helping patients rebuild function and confidence after complex tooth loss. She is known for a calm, methodical approach and for explaining the trade-offs of each option without pressure.

Her clinical interests include implant-supported restorations, full mouth rehabilitation and the conservative management of tooth wear. She works closely with the laboratory to ensure that the details — shade, texture and bite — are right.

name: Dr. Rohan Mehta
intro: Rohan oversees implant and surgical care at the studio. He plans every case digitally before surgery, with a particular focus on preserving bone and gum architecture around implants.

He is a firm believer in honest case selection: if an implant is not the right answer, he will say so and explain what is. His surgical manner is unhurried, and anxious patients are a routine part of his day.

name: Dr. Elena Marchetti
intro: Elena leads the orthodontic service, treating adults and teenagers with both fixed appliances and clear aligner systems. Her planning philosophy is conservative: move only what needs moving, and protect the gums throughout.
She takes time to show patients their scans and simulations, so the expected result — and its limits — are understood before treatment starts.

name: Dr. Sofia Alvarez
intro: Sofia works with patients who want to refine their smile without it looking obviously treated. She favours composite bonding and minimal-preparation ceramics, and is meticulous about shade and surface texture.
Before any cosmetic work, she insists on a healthy foundation — stable gums, treated decay and a comfortable bite — because good aesthetics do not last on an unhealthy mouth.

name: Dr. Priya Nair
intro: Priya looks after our youngest patients, from first visits to teenage orthodontic referrals. Her approach is built on trust: nothing happens until a child is comfortable, and parents are involved at every step.
She has a particular interest in early prevention and in helping anxious children build a positive relationship with dental care that lasts into adulthood.

name: Dr. James Whitfield
intro: James focuses on saving teeth that others might consider for extraction. Using magnification and modern rotary systems, he manages complex canal anatomy and re-treatment cases with a quiet, precise technique.
He is candid about prognosis: some teeth are worth investing in, and some are not. He will give you a realistic view before you commit to treatment.
